cases.title: Valid login + OTP succeeds
cases.actionSteps: 1) Go to portal.govectora.com 2) Enter valid email/password 3) Submit 4) Enter 6-digit OTP 5) Submit
cases.expected: Dashboard loads; sidebar shows the full nav list

cases.title: Invalid password rejected
cases.actionSteps: 1) Enter valid email + wrong password 2) Submit
cases.expected: Inline error; no OTP step reached

cases.title: Invalid OTP rejected
cases.expected: Error shown; access denied

cases.title: Session sign-out
cases.expected: Returns to login screen; protected routes unreachable

cases.title: Portal user blocked from Admin panel
cases.actionSteps: 1) Attempt to open admin.govectora.com in the same session/browser profile
cases.expected: Portal credentials do not grant Admin access (separate auth realm)

cases.title: First-run onboarding tour
cases.expected: Tour dismissible via Skip; does not block navigation

cases.title: Today-at-a-glance cards render
cases.actionSteps: 1) Observe Active Passengers, Today's Trips, In Progress, Completed Today, Open Incidents cards
cases.expected: Counts render and match underlying data (e.g. Active Passengers = 2 in test tenant)

cases.title: Trip Status Mix chart (last 30 days)
cases.expected: Bars/legend for Scheduled/Dispatched/Accepted/In Progress/Completed/Cancelled/Not Completed render without error

cases.title: No-shows counter excluded from trip counts
cases.actionSteps: 1) Compare "No-shows (passengers)" tile to Trip Status Mix totals
cases.expected: No-shows tracked separately, footnoted as "not counted as trips"

cases.title: Drivers Compliance summary tile
cases.expected: Matches Driver Compliance page totals

cases.title: Today's Trip Feed empty/populated state
cases.expected: Shows "No trips scheduled for today" when empty, or a list when populated

cases.title: Passengers list scoped to tenant
cases.expected: Only this client's passengers appear (2 in test tenant); Name/Status columns present

cases.title: Add Passenger form (observe only, do not submit)
cases.actionSteps: 1) Open Add Passenger 2) Inspect required fields
cases.expected: Form opens with the same field groupings as Admin's passenger form scoped to this client; do not save

cases.title: "My Requests" tab
cases.expected: Shows client-submitted request history/status (Passenger Request type from Admin's Request SLA config)

cases.title: Export controls
cases.expected: Export completes without error

cases.title: Column visibility toggle
cases.actionSteps: 1) Open Columns control 2) Toggle a column
cases.expected: Column show/hide persists during session

cases.title: Route Sheets list scoped & paired RSO/RSR
cases.expected: Shows only this client's route sheets; Outbound/Return pairs share numeric suffix (e.g. RSO-0003/RSR-0003)

cases.title: Active Trips tab
cases.expected: Shows today's trips for this client only, if any

cases.title: Future Trips are read-only
cases.actionSteps: 1) Open tab 2) Inspect available row actions
cases.expected: No dispatch/status-change action available — consistent with today-only dispatch rule

cases.title: Trips History read-only
cases.expected: Past trips listed; no mutating actions available

cases.title: On Demand Trips tab
cases.expected: Renders without error (empty or populated)

cases.title: Active Days chip display
cases.actionSteps: 1) Inspect Active Days column on a row
cases.expected: 7-day chip strip (M–S) highlights the correct scheduled days

cases.title: Incidents list scoped & read-only
cases.expected: Only this client's incidents shown (0 in test tenant → "No incidents have been reported"); no create/edit actions

cases.title: Incident detail linkage (data-dependent)
cases.expected: Links back to the source trip/passenger event (No Show / Early Cancel / Late Cancel)
cases.regr: No — data-dependent, currently empty in test tenant

cases.title: Driver Compliance tab scoped
cases.expected: Only drivers assigned to this client's routes shown; Expiring/Expired summary tiles at top

cases.title: Compliance thresholds match Admin config
cases.actionSteps: 1) Compare "Expiring within 30 days" tile logic to Admin Settings Compliance Thresholds
cases.expected: Same 30-day/7-day windows apply

cases.title: Monitor Compliance sub-tab
cases.expected: Renders monitor compliance rows scoped to this client

cases.title: Export controls
cases.expected: Completes without error

cases.title: Invoices list scoped, empty state
cases.expected: Only this client's invoices shown (0 in test tenant → "No invoices found for your organization")

cases.title: Invoice status values (data-dependent)
cases.expected: Status is one of Draft/Sent/Paid/Overdue
cases.regr: No — data-dependent, currently empty in test tenant

cases.title: No payment-initiation controls present
cases.expected: Portal is view/download only — no "Pay Now" or payment-method entry point

cases.title: Empty state without a contract
cases.expected: Shows "No contracts on file yet. Budget tracking will appear once a contract is set up."

cases.title: Populated view (data-dependent)
cases.preconditions: A client with a contract on file
cases.expected: Budget tracking widgets render using Admin-configured Economics Cost Defaults
cases.regr: No — data-dependent, no contracted client currently available in test tenant

cases.title: Spend Report sub-tabs render
cases.actionSteps: 1) Open Spend, Trips, Passengers, Incidents, Compliance sub-tabs in turn
cases.expected: Each renders without error, scoped to this client

cases.title: Report Filters control
cases.expected: Filter panel opens; applying/resetting works

cases.title: Messaging entry point
cases.expected: Message center opens (scoped to this client's conversations)

cases.title: Notifications scoped & unread state
cases.expected: Only this client's/user's notifications shown

cases.title: Dark/light mode toggle
cases.expected: Switches instantly; persists

cases.title: No cross-client data leakage
cases.actionSteps: 1) Inspect all rows across Passengers, Route Sheets, Incidents, Compliance, Invoices
cases.expected: Every row belongs to this portal user's own `client_id` — none from other clients

cases.title: Pagination defaults consistent with Admin
cases.expected: 10 per page, matching Admin convention

cases.title: Global Search scope (if present)
cases.actionSteps: 1) Open search 2) Query a passenger name
cases.expected: Results limited to this client's own data

cases.title: Help link
cases.expected: Contextual help content loads without error
